# Vix

> Vix is a keyboard-friendly terminal text editor (a "Simple Terminal Rust
> IDE") built on ratatui: a thin App shell (package `vix-tui` in `tui/`,
> building the `vix` command) over 147 focused `vix-*` member crates in a
> Cargo workspace (edition 2024), with desktop GUIs in `gui/`.

Development is specification-driven: each crate owns a spec at
`crates/<crate>/spec/index.md`; cross-cutting and app-level specs live under
`spec/`. When behavior and spec disagree, decide which is correct and make
them match. [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) is the canonical entry point for both
human and AI contributors — read it first. The workspace version is 2.0.2
(released 2026-11-07).

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): entry point — what Vix is, build/test/lint, hard
  rules, non-negotiable conventions, where things live, the change checklist
- [index.md](index.md): user-facing overview — features, install & run,
  configuration, license
- [docs/index.md](docs/index.md): the full documentation map
- [docs/getting-started/index.md](docs/getting-started/index.md): install,
  first run, the published install channels
- [spec/index/index.md](spec/index/index.md): specification overview — goals,
  dependency crates, build/run

## User guides

- [Architecture](docs/architecture/index.md): workspace layout (App shell +
  `vix-*` member crates), event flow, rendering, theming, i18n, configuration,
  testing
- [Keybindings](docs/keybindings/index.md): every keyboard shortcut and mouse
  gesture, including keymaps
- [Configuration](docs/configuration/index.md): settings file, every key, CLI
  flags
- [Keymaps](docs/keymaps/index.md): Apple, VSCode, Emacs, Vi, Spacemacs,
  IntelliJ, Eclipse, Sublime, Zed
- [Menus](docs/menus/index.md), [Themes](docs/themes/index.md),
  [Internationalization](docs/internationalization/index.md)
- [Generated action reference](docs/reference/actions.md): every action id,
  its title and menu path, generated from the real catalog
- [Language Server Protocol](docs/language-server-protocol/index.md):
  diagnostics, hover, go-to-definition, completion, progress
- [Debugger](docs/debugger/index.md): Debug Adapter Protocol — breakpoints
  with conditions, exception filters, attach, stepping, call stack, variables
  tree, watches, inline values
- [IDE parity features](docs/ide-parity/index.md): Local History, Search
  Everywhere, Refactor… and Organize Imports, run configurations, peek
  definition, CodeLens, postfix completion
- [What's new in 2.0](docs/whats-new-2-0/index.md): user-facing release notes for
  2.0 — highlights, upgrading, what is not done
- [Launch kit](docs/launch/index.md): announcement drafts for 2.0 (never posted)
- [Remote editing](docs/remote-editing/index.md): open a folder over SSH
  (experimental) — search, git, language servers, terminal, remote agent
- [Cowork](docs/cowork/index.md): real-time co-editing, opt-in `cowork`
  build feature (not in the default build)
- [IM](docs/im/index.md): code-aware chat, threads anchored to lines, IRCv3
- [MCP server](docs/mcp-server/index.md): `vix --mcp` serves Vix's view of a
  workspace to an AI agent over the Model Context Protocol
- [Large File Viewer](docs/large-file-viewer/index.md): read-only viewer for
  multi-gigabyte files
- [OC (containers)](docs/oc/index.md): Docker, Podman and nerdctl
- [Database Workbench](docs/db/index.md): SQLite/PostgreSQL/MySQL —
  connections, schema tree, query editor, transactions, history, export
- [Org mode](docs/org/index.md): headlines, TODO cycling, table editor,
  Org-roam, export
- [Git Panel](docs/git-panel/index.md): status, diff, blame, stage/unstage/
  revert per hunk
- [Branch review](docs/branch-review/index.md): a branch or commit range as
  one diff, with saved line comments exported as Markdown
- [Change gutter base](docs/gutter-base/index.md): compare the change gutter
  with HEAD, the index, the saved file or a branch
- [Interactive rebase](docs/interactive-rebase/index.md): reorder, reword,
  squash, drop and cherry-pick without an external editor
- [Inline suggestions](docs/ghost-text/index.md): dimmed ghost-text completion
  from an LSP server or an AI provider (off by default)
- [Safe save](docs/safe-save/index.md): atomic saves that keep hard links and
  ownership, and what an interrupted save leaves behind
- [Project environment](docs/project-environment/index.md): direnv, mise and
  `.venv` applied to servers, tasks and terminals, gated by workspace trust
- [Terminal](docs/terminal/index.md): several shells, scrollback, Ctrl+click
  to open output paths, send selection, restart
- [Scripting](docs/scripting/index.md): Rhai `.rhai` scripts — new palette
  commands, key bindings, buffer transforms, no rebuild
- [Performance](docs/performance/index.md): measured numbers, with the
  machine and method stated

## Specification (source of truth)

- [CI/CD](spec/ci/index.md): GitHub, GitLab, and Codeberg pipelines; the local
  parity gate (`scripts/check`)
- [Capability Cargo features](spec/cargo-features/index.md): which
  capabilities a build can leave out, and the opt-in `cowork` feature
- [Remote editing](spec/remote-editing/index.md),
  [Cowork](spec/cowork/index.md), [IM](spec/instant-message/index.md),
  [MCP server](spec/mcp-server/index.md), [Jupyter](spec/jupyter/index.md)
  (spike done, not implemented)
- [Overlay priority](spec/overlay-priority/index.md): one table orders
  overlay drawing and key routing
- [Navigation](spec/navigation/index.md), [Tools menu](spec/tools/index.md),
  [Comparisons](spec/comparisons/index.md), [Test strategy](spec/test/index.md)
- [agents/share/crate-map.md](agents/share/crate-map.md): every crate, module,
  and file
